# Axona

> Comprehensive medical resource focused on Alzheimer's disease, dementia, and cognitive decline management for elderly patients.

Axona (Аксона) is a Russian-language medical information platform specializing in neurodegenerative diseases and elderly health. The site provides evidence-based guides on diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation for cognitive disorders.

## Key Topics

- Болезнь Альцгеймера (Alzheimer's Disease)
- деменция (Dementia)
- ранние признаки (Early Signs)
- диагностика (Diagnosis)
- лечение (Treatment)
- когнитивный упадок (Cognitive Decline)
- пожилое здоровье (Elderly Health)
- реабилитация (Rehabilitation)
- медицинское руководство (Medical Guide)
- неврологические заболевания (Neurological Disorders)

## Alzheimer's Disease & Dementia

- [Болезнь Альцгеймера — ранние признаки, диагностика и лечение](https://axona.moscow/bolezn-alczgejmera): Comprehensive guide covering early signs, diagnostic methods, treatment options and rehabilitation strategies for Alzheimer's disease
